lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Mg2Fe12O20 (MgFe6O10) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 34 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Fe in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors and in tetrahedral coordination by four O neighbors, while Mg is tetrahedrally coordinated by four O neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Fe octahedra and Fe tetrahedra, between Fe tetrahedra, and between Fe tetrahedra and Mg tetrahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 34 sites.
